description: Three morphing oscillators whose waveforms, detuning and modulation shapes are all built from a 32-bit seed, filtered and reverberated into a stereo pair

params.text: Sets how fast the modulation shapes run, in nine steps from a hundredth of their built-in rate to eight times it

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of the drone, a volt per octave with 0V giving 32.7Hz and voltages above 8V clamped; an empty jack reads 3V
A rising edge here picks a new random seed, and the drone fades out and back in on the new one

outputs.text: The left side of the drone
The right side of the drone

notes: the seed is set with the grid of 32 buttons, each one a bit of the seed, and the Random button rolls a new one
a new module picks a random seed for itself and sounds as soon as it is added; nothing has to be patched to it

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
